identification: Two small framed abstract works by Ryllton Viney (b. 5 May 1944, Launceston painter exhibiting for 50+ years, UTAS-trained, represented by Madeline Gordon Gallery; listed in Germaine's Artists and Galleries of Australia). One near-square dark brown/black textured piece with pale forms at the base, one landscape-format red/orange/white abstract, each roughly 8-11 cm image in a wide white mat, black frames about 30 x 25 cm. Textured mixed media/acrylic on paper or board; look original, not prints.
